name: University of Memphis
tuition_note: In-state (TN resident) undergraduate tuition & fees: full-time (12+ hrs) = $5,880/semester ($4,872 tuition + $1,008 University Service Fee) = $11,760/year, from 2026-27 Resident Undergraduate fee chart at memphis.edu/usbs/fees/ (ug_resident.pdf). Housing is room only from memphis.edu/reslife/housing101/housingrates.php; used South Hall standard double $2,957/semester x 2 = $5,914/year (2025-2026). Standard traditional doubles range $2,582-$3,337/semester; apartment-style up to $4,103/semester.
